# FG-LLM-0006

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `evidence_outside_input_dropped` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: AI の指摘の一部は、根拠が入力に見つからなかったため表示しません。
- en: Some AI findings are not shown because their evidence was not found in the input.
- id: Beberapa temuan AI tidak ditampilkan karena buktinya tidak ditemukan dalam input.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 19 §3.1, §5 (ADR-0039): findings of a valid answer quoted text that is not in the input (in the parts of the finding's path when it names one, or anywhere otherwise), quoted fewer than 8 characters, named a path the input does not have, or had nothing left after mentions and links were stripped. Those findings alone were dropped; the advice keeps the rest and says how many were dropped. Typical of a model that invents code, or of injected text that tries to plant a finding.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The gateway logs it once per advice with `llm_request_id`, `purpose`, `dropped` and `kept`; `forge_llm_requests_total{purpose,outcome}` is unaffected (the advice is written). Many per advice for one model or prompt version: compare `SELECT prompt_version, count(*) FROM forge.llm_requests WHERE purpose = '<purpose>' GROUP BY 1`.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing for single advices. A rising share after a prompt or model change: roll it back (runbook llm-advice-quality) and add the cases to the eval set.
